question: Is there anything about your day-to-day life you'd like us to talk more about?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “Yes, keeping on top of my own jobs without someone having to remind me quite so much. I don’t mind my housemate helping—they’re good about it—but I like doing my share. The walking group’s something I enjoy, and I want to keep washing the bibs. It’s just those little bits between getting them washed and actually getting out the door that seem to trip me up.”
